title: Deal drops Anker’s 20,000mAh Travel Essential power bank to just $59.99
summary: Save 14% on the Anker Travel Essential power bank, a 20,000mAh charger with 87W output and a built-in USB-C cable.

That’s why this Amazon deal on the Anker Power Bank 20,000mAh Travel Essential is worth a look, with the portable charger down to $59.99. See the deal at Amazon

title: Garmin unveils the MARQ 3 series: 6 luxury smartwatches for every lifestyle
summary: Garmin's MARQ 3 smartwatches target aviators, athletes, divers, and golfers.
body: Credit: Garmin TL;DR Garmin has officially launched the MARQ 3 series. The new lineup of luxury smartwatches includes six models: the MARQ Adventurer, MARQ Athlete, MARQ Aviator, MARQ Commander, MARQ Diver, and MARQ Golfer. The MARQ 3 family starts at a retail price of $2,500. Garmin has been working on a follow-up to the MARQ Gen 2. While a leak spoiled the surprise, that didn’t stop the company from sneaking up on us with the release. Only a day after said leak emerged online, the third generation of the MARQ series is now rolling out. Garmin has announced the rollout of the MARQ 3 series, the company’s luxury line of smartwatches. Included in this family are six models: the MARQ Adventurer, MARQ Athlete, MARQ Aviator, MARQ Commander, MARQ Diver, and MARQ Golfer.

title: Anker’s tiny Nano Charger Neo 45W drops to just $19.99
summary: Save 23% on the Anker Nano Charger Neo 45W, a compact USB-C charger with a built-in display and travel-friendly design.
body: Amazon has dropped the Anker Nano Charger Neo, Dynamic 45W to $19.99, down from its $25.99 recommended retail price. That saves you $6, which is a 23% discount relative to the RRP. Better still, this is the lowest price we have seen this year, and it has never been cheaper, so it looks like a good time to grab one. See the deal at Amazon
